content-understanding-advanced-tokens.title: Agentic mode can use more Foundry model tokens than this estimate shows
content-understanding-advanced-tokens.body: Contextualization here is priced at a fixed rate per page, image, hour of audio or hour of video. If you use agentic mode, Microsoft notes it can consume more Foundry model tokens than a nonagentic workflow; those tokens bill on your Foundry deployment, not in this estimate, so test with representative documents.

citation.quote: It can also consume more model tokens than a nonagentic workflow. Test with representative documents when you estimate costs.

content-understanding-model-tokens-separ.title: Model token usage is billed on your Foundry deployment, not in Content Understanding
content-understanding-model-tokens-separ.body: Generative features are on in this estimate. Microsoft states the language model and embedding tokens appear on your Foundry model deployment, so add that deployment as its own component.

citation.quote: You don't see any LLM or embedding token usage billing in Content Understanding. That usage appears on your Foundry model deployment.
